credential_policy: Settings UI credentials are process-memory only. Environment and ignored LocalConfig credentials remain supported for development.
fallback_policy: Invalid configuration, missing credentials, transport errors, non-2xx responses, malformed output, validation failures, or irrelevant performance tails always return the deterministic semantic spine.
notes: The model may add only an optional persona tail. Rules, conditions, facts, stance, task state, and the semantic spine remain local and deterministic.
